title.en: Pass rectifying entries for two-sided errors.
Use the three-step method: wrong entry, correct entry, rectifying entry.

say.en: An accountant never uses an eraser. Errors are corrected by passing a fresh journal entry. In this lesson: Pass rectifying entries for two-sided errors.
Use the three-step method: wrong entry, correct entry, rectifying entry.

body.en: Step 1: write the entry that was actually (wrongly) passed. Step 2: write the entry that should have been passed. Step 3: debit the account that was wrongly credited or not debited enough, and credit the account that was wrongly debited or not credited enough. *Two-sided errors* are always corrected by a full journal entry between the two accounts.

The rectifying entry moves the amount to the Furniture account. With a ₹20,000 error, by how much is gross profit understated? Pass the rectifying entry. Which two accounts change?
narration.kn: ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದ ಪೀಠೋಪಕರಣ ಖರೀದಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿ ಖತಾವಣೆ ಆಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ತಾಳೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಸಮ, ಆದರೆ ಖರೀದಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ನಮೂದು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಪೀಠೋಪಕರಣ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ವರ್ಗಾಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ₹20,000 ತಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಲಾಭ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಡಿಮೆ? ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ನಮೂದು ಮಾಡಿ. ಯಾವ ಎರಡು ಖಾತೆಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

title.en: On the board: Rectifying two-sided errors

say.en: Three steps: what was done, what should have been done, then the entry that bridges the two.
Furniture debited to purchases: debit furniture, credit purchases with 10,000.
Credit sale to Kiran not recorded: nothing to cancel, so pass the full entry.
Cash from Arun credited to Varun: debit Varun to cancel, credit Arun to correct.
Check with T accounts: purchases was debited 10,000 wrongly; the credit cancels it.

problem.en: Pass rectifying entries: (i) Furniture bought for ₹10,000 was debited to the purchases account. (ii) A credit sale of ₹4,000 to Kiran was not recorded at all. (iii) Cash ₹3,000 received from Arun was credited to Varun's account.

steps.en: (i) Wrong: Purchases Dr 10,000. Correct: Furniture Dr 10,000. Rectify: Furniture A/c Dr ₹10,000 To Purchases A/c ₹10,000.
(ii) Nothing was recorded, so pass the full entry: Kiran A/c Dr ₹4,000 To Sales A/c ₹4,000.
(iii) Wrong: credited Varun. Correct: credit Arun. Rectify: Varun A/c Dr ₹3,000 To Arun A/c ₹3,000.

answer.en: Furniture Dr / Purchases Cr ₹10,000; Kiran Dr / Sales Cr ₹4,000; Varun Dr / Arun Cr ₹3,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Pass rectifying entries: (i) Furniture bought for ₹10,000 was debited to the purchases account. (ii) A credit sale of ₹4,000 to Kiran was not recorded at all. (iii) Cash ₹3,000 received from Arun was credited to Varun's account.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Pass rectifying entries: i Furniture bought for 10,000 rupees was debited to the purchases account. ii A credit sale of 4,000 rupees to Kiran was not recorded at all. iii Cash 3,000 rupees received from Arun was credited to Varun's account.
i Wrong: Purchases Dr 10,000. Correct: Furniture Dr 10,000. Rectify: Furniture A over c Dr 10,000 rupees To Purchases A over c 10,000 rupees.
ii Nothing was recorded, so pass the full entry: Kiran A over c Dr 4,000 rupees To Sales A over c 4,000 rupees.
iii Wrong: credited Varun. Correct: credit Arun. Rectify: Varun A over c Dr 3,000 rupees To Arun A over c 3,000 rupees.
So the answer is Furniture Dr divided by Purchases Cr 10,000 rupees; Kiran Dr divided by Sales Cr 4,000 rupees; Varun Dr divided by Arun Cr 3,000 rupees.
